documents.title: BT0035 - Policy on Artificial Intelligence
documents.summary: A UT System Board policy, covering UT Knoxville, that embraces AI in teaching while leaving each instructor to decide whether, when and how AI is used. It requires campuses to set procedures covering communication, three example tiers of use, academic integrity, and detection tools, and bars entering protected data into unreviewed tools.
documents.stance_why: The policy sets no single rule; it says each faculty member 'shall consider whether, when, and how AI may be used, if at all' and offers 'Unrestricted Use', 'Mixed Use' and 'Total Prohibition' as options, so the decision is delegated to instructors and the tiers are listed.

units.fit_note: Also records that a state statute (Tennessee Public Chapter 550, 2024) required the policy.
